candidate_universe.source: M4 effective development candidate pool minus current HF13 and external registry

inputs: adjacent jumps and standardized M4 physical feature space
normalization: candidate-pool min-max after exclusions; physical distances from frozen standardized M4 feature space; no HF target normalization

proxy_definitions.RT_residual: aggregate CNN-LF and CNN-MLP T/R disagreement
proxy_definitions.coverage: physical feature-space distance to current HF13, capped at 90th percentile
proxy_definitions.eta_plus1_absolute_residual: calibrated LF eta(+1) disagreement plus CNN/MLP and LF model discrepancy; heuristic only
proxy_definitions.performance: M4 performance potential, used only as one role component
proxy_definitions.tail_error: maximum normalized disagreement and robust-response stress

roles.COVERAGE-EXTRAPOLATION-CONTROL: largest representative HF13 feature-space gap, capped against isolated extremes
roles.ERROR-1: highest calibrated-LF residual risk without pathological exclusion
roles.PERFORMANCE+ERROR: high broadband eta(+1) potential with material disagreement

scope: development-only error-region acquisition design; zero solver; no external/sealed target reads

selection_policy.redundancy_penalty: 0.25 when physical feature distance below 1.0; deterministic greedy selection
